defense_in_depth: order_pipeline.incomplete_explicit_rate holds a structured infusion that carries a rate with no units, an adjustment with no rate, a role-named adjustment in a unit no vasoactive runs in, and (with the order's text) a rate_mcg_min that is not written with its unit; each barrier of a target-as-rate or incomplete-rate order protects alone, nitroglycerin included

faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-01: L-1 unit compatibility: an adjustment to an active vasoactive infusion never assumes mcg/min; a rate is executable only if its drug is attributed, the rate is explicit, the unit is explicit AND supported for that drug; fail closed otherwise.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-02: L-2 rate attribution: the rate of another medication in the same clause or bundle is never attributed to norepinephrine, epinephrine, dobutamine or nitroglycerin; ownership is drug-specific and structurally justified, no nearest-number heuristic, no cross-drug inheritance.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-03: L-3 stop attribution: a stop inherited from a list, bundle, prior clause or neighbouring medication does not stop a vasoactive infusion unless it is unambiguously attributed to that drug; an ambiguous stop fails closed.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-04: L-4 deferred '/min': the '/min' of a deferred or unrelated order is never read as a duration or another field that makes a vasoactive order executable; explicit valid rate-unit parsing is preserved; no broad grammar redesign.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-05: L-5: 'restart norepinephrine' with no explicit supported absolute rate is the approved incomplete-rate clarification; the previous rate is not reused; nothing executes.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-06: L-6: 'continue norepinephrine at 12' is INCOMPLETE_EXPLICIT_RATE and asks for units; 'continue norepinephrine at 12 mcg/min' is valid.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-07: L-7: the downstream defense-in-depth barrier understands the existing nitroglycerin-style field rate_mcg_min, so nitroglycerin no longer relies on source parsing alone; no physiology change and no new generic medication schema.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-08: L-8: a numeric-only answer to a dose/rate question never becomes an executable vasoactive rate; explicit rate AND supported units are required; units are never inferred from the active infusion, a previous order, the question's wording or a drug default.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-09: PERMANENT_FAIL_CLOSED stays for the shadow after a malformed or unsupported order; no recovery in this package.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-10: RAW_ORDER_REMAINS_CORRECT_BOUNDARY stays for the shared mirror; no raw/resolved hybrid.
faculty_decisions.FD-ORDER-11: Out of scope: automatic MAP/SBP-target titration, mcg/kg/min conversion, relative rate arithmetic, another vasopressor or drug, pump-specific physiology, tone recalibration, authority expansion.

def _drug_name_spans(body, own, own_kind=None):
    """``[(start, end, "own" | "other")]`` for each medicine name in the piece: the words this piece's order is about (``own``), and every other medicine the reader can see."""
    own_names = own + (r"|" + _RECOGNISED_ALIASES[own_kind] if own_kind in _RECOGNISED_ALIASES else "")
    spans = [(m.start(), m.end(), "own") for m in re.finditer(r"\b(?:" + own_names + r")\b", body)]
    others = [r"(?:" + pattern + r")" for other, pattern in _VASOACTIVE_ALIASES.items() if other != own_kind]
    others += [r"(?:" + pattern + r")" for other, pattern in _RECOGNISED_ALIASES.items() if other != own_kind]
    others.append(r"(?:" + _OTHER_INFUSION_AGENTS + r")")
    others += [r"(?:" + pattern + r")" for agents in _AGENTS.values() for pattern in agents.values()]
    spans += [(m.start(), m.end(), "other") for m in re.finditer(r"\b(?:" + "|".join(others) + r")\b", body)]
    return sorted(spans)


def _rate_claimant(body, literal, spans):
    """Which drug a written rate belongs to: ``"own"``, ``"other"`` or ``None`` (no drug claims it). Never the nearest name by distance: the drug named just before the number
    with only the connectors of a dose between them, or the drug a trailing "of <drug>" names."""
    trailing = re.match(r"\s*(?:of|de|del)\s+(?:the\s+|la\s+|el\s+)?", body[literal.end():])
    if trailing:
        begins = literal.end() + trailing.end()
        for start, end, who in spans:
            if start == begins:
                # "12 mcg/min of propofol" is propofol's, whatever is written before the number (adversarial review F10).
                return who
    before = [span for span in spans if span[1] <= literal.start()]
    if before:
        start, end, who = before[-1]
        if _DOSE_CONNECTORS.fullmatch(body[end:literal.start()]):
            return who
    return None


def _own_rate_literals(body, own, own_kind, literals):
    """``(mine, foreign, ambiguous)``: the rate literals of the piece split by who they belong to. A piece that names no other medicine keeps every literal as before."""
    spans = _drug_name_spans(body, own, own_kind)
    if not any(who == "other" for _, _, who in spans):
        return list(literals), [], []
    mine, foreign, ambiguous = [], [], []
    for literal in literals:
        who = _rate_claimant(body, literal, spans)
        (mine if who == "own" else foreign if who == "other" else ambiguous).append(literal)
    return mine, foreign, ambiguous

    return not re.sub(r"[\s.,;:!?()\-]+", "", rest)

statement: The order reader (family_parser.py) was changed a SECOND time under the faculty's lifting of its freeze for a narrowly scoped safety correction: a rate and a stop belong to ONE drug, restart and continue with no explicit rate are the approved question. The reader of the first successor and the reader of the Phase-2 closure both stay reconstructable byte for byte and in behavior; every Phase-2 digest recomputes from the closure reader; the calibration freeze moved in exactly one component and the materialized scenario inputs did not move; nothing sealed was rewritten and nothing in clinical_core/ was edited.
what_changed_in_behavior: an adjustment named only by its role is held unless its unit is one a vasoactive infusion runs in (and mcg/kg/min is not one nitroglycerin runs in)
a rate another medicine of the same piece claims is never an infusion's: the whole piece is held
a stop is taken by a vasoactive infusion only if the verb governs its name (never inherited by an order that says more, never through an exception)
the '/min' of a mass-per-time rate unit is not a duration (time_semantics)
a restart with no explicit rate is the approved incomplete-rate question
a number beside 'continue' is incomplete, not a silent continue
the pipeline barrier reads rate_mcg_min and requires the number to be written with its unit
the legacy page takes no unit from the running infusion or the drug's usual one
an exception ends the stop for the pieces after it; one stop that names two infusions is not read (never chosen by the reader's priority)
an answer to 'what rate?' is one rate with its unit for the drug that asked, with no other medicine and no time to wait for (family path and legacy page path)
an incomplete order of a deferred part is asked, never dropped; 'nor-epi' is never read as epinephrine; the word 'infusion' and the micro sign are not a duration
what_did_not_change: the physiology constants, the tone parameters and the pump coupling
runtime_shadow.py (the raw order stays the boundary; the shadow stays PERMANENT_FAIL_CLOSED)
